section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Wipers and Washers
ocr_text:
2. INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES STOPPING AT STOP POSITION
(a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 3. Connect the negative (—) lead to the motor body. Operates the motor.
(b) Stop motor operation anywhere except stop position by disconnecting terminal 3.
(c) Connect terminals 3 and 4.
(d) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1.
(e) Check that the motor stops running at stop position after the motor operates again.
If operation is not as specified, replace the motor.
